generation: monotonic per BrowserRuntimeLifecycle instance; artifact manifest generation remains a separate identity
readiness: exactly one popcorn_app_ready event while the activation is in starting state
terminal_cleanup: all owned resources are released in reverse ownership order before stopped is emitted

retry.artifact_cache: no retained host cache; acquisition uses fetch cache=no-store

late_completion: generation mismatch or stopped/stopping state increments stale_drops and cannot become ready
navigation: pagehide invokes the same idempotent stop path as explicit disposal
limitations: browser process termination is owned by the browser and cannot emit completion evidence
support and production retry policy remain unclaimed
